title: Luxical: High-Speed Lexical-Dense Text Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2512.09015v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Frontier language model quality increasingly hinges on our ability to organize web-scale text corpora for training. Today's dominant tools trade off speed and flexibility: lexical classifiers (e.g., FastText) are fast but limited to producing classification output scores, while the vector-valued outputs of transformer text embedding models flexibly support numerous workflows (e.g., clustering, classification, and retrieval) but are computationally expensive to produce. We introduce Luxical, a library for high-speed "lexical-dense" text embeddings that aims to recover the best properties of both approaches for web-scale text organization. Luxical combines sparse TF--IDF features, a small ReLU network, and a knowledge distillation training regimen to approximate large transformer embedding models at a fraction of their operational cost. translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.09015v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：前沿语言模型的质量在很大程度上取决于我们组织网络规模文本语料库以用于训练的能力。当今的主流工具在速度与灵活性之间存在权衡：词汇分类器（如FastText）速度快但仅限于生成分类输出分数，而Transformer文本嵌入模型的向量输出能够灵活支持多种工作流程（如聚类、分类和检索），但其计算成本高昂。我们推出了Luxical，一个用于高速“词汇密集”文本嵌入的库，旨在为网络规模的文本组织任务同时兼顾两种方法的最佳特性。Luxical结合了稀疏TF-IDF特征、一个小型ReLU网络以及知识蒸馏训练方案，以仅为大模型一小部分的运行成本来近似大型Transformer嵌入模型。在本技术报告中，我们描述了Luxical的架构和训练目标，并评估了……
tldr: Luxical通过结合稀疏TF-IDF特征、小型ReLU网络和知识蒸馏训练，以极低的计算成本近似大型Transformer嵌入模型，实现了面向网络规模文本组织的高速“词汇密集”文本嵌入。
